location: Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
role_summary: FinOps role for an insurance environment covering AWS, OCI and hybrid cloud cost management with automation, reporting and governance.
responsibility_text: Cloud cost analysis and cost visibility; rightsizing, Reserved Instances, autoscaling and storage lifecycle; cost anomaly management; tagging, chargeback, showback and cost allocation; budgeting, forecasting and reconciliation; cost-efficient architecture; unit economics and leadership reporting. Partner with Cloud Engineering team, Finance team, Security and Application teams, Product Owners and Business Managers.
requirement_text: AWS and OCI pricing and billing; Python automation and API integrations; Terraform; CI/CD cost policy controls; Power BI, Grafana, QuickSight or OCI Analytics; multi-cloud cost tools including CloudHealth, Apptio, Flexera and Cloudability.
preferred_text: FinOps Certified Practitioner or Professional; AWS Cloud Financial Management; Azure Cost Management; Google Cloud Digital Leader; CCSP; Power BI Data Analyst Associate.
